::: {#perfil}

MSc student in Applied Mathematics and Data Science at FGV EMAp, holding an MSc and a BSc in Economics from FGV EPGE. He works as a senior data scientist at MT2 Data.

## Education

- MSc in Applied Mathematics and Data Science — FGV EMAp, 2025–2027
- MSc in Economics — FGV EPGE, 2020–2023
- BSc in Economics — FGV EPGE, 2017–2020

## Interests

Causal inference, econometrics, and programming in Python, R, and Julia.
